validation_gates.date: must parse against the source's declared date formats; rows with unparseable dates go to quarantine, never the ledger
validation_gates.url: item links must match the source's allowed_domains; anything else quarantined
validation_gates.title: 8–300 chars after whitespace collapse
validation_gates.dedupe: sha1(normalized_title + date) primary; PDF filename secondary; 'also' array records cross-listings
validation_gates.failure_policy: a fetch failure or empty parse NEVER passes silently — source health is set to FAILED/WARN with a note, and two consecutive failures raise an alert on the dashboard

classification.note: No tiers. One deterministic split: an item is either substantive or routine. What the document IS comes from its own type label, taken from the source. Audit with code/audit_routine.py — the ledger and this regex must agree exactly.
classification.routine_regex: (?i)assess(es|ed)? (mobile )?network quality|subscription data|performance indicator report|quarterly highlights|panel of auditors|sitting of hon|non-sitting|internship|research associate|vacancy circular|recruitment|seminar|workshop|\bTSTL\b|designat(es|ed)\b.{0,60}\blaborator|empanel|certificate and internship
classification.memo_note: A memo is drafted for a new, non-routine item whose type is in memo_types. Drafts, consultations, releases, notices and designations do not trigger a memo.
